body: Lieutenant Steve Farris, Chief Pilot and Aviation Section Commander for the Seminole County Sheriff's Office in Florida, has spent more than three decades in law enforcement, beginning with ride-alongs alongside sheriff's deputies as a teenager in 1989. A fifth-generation Floridian, he joined the agency's aviation work after it acquired its first military surplus helicopters in 1996, became a full-time pilot in 1999, and now leads its aviation section.

The agency transitioned to an all-Airbus fleet in 2006. Over the last two decades, its 10-person aviation team has logged 20,000 flight hours in Airbus helicopters, operating around the clock and flying roughly 1,000 hours a year. In 2025, its two ALERT helicopters responded to nearly 1,400 calls for service, including 965 from the Seminole County Sheriff's Office, 167 for the Sanford Police Department and 46 for the Altamonte Springs Police Department.

The unit's Airbus H125s supported 104 arrests, 44 dedicated surveillance missions and the recovery of nine stolen vehicles in 2025, and helped locate 96 individuals, including 30 missing persons. The same year, its crews carried out 148 water drops to help stop brush fires before they reached suburban property lines, using the H125's hoist and water bucket for rescues and firefighting in Seminole County's wilderness trails and waterways.
en.summary: Seminole County Sheriff's Office aviation chief Steve Farris describes how the agency's all-Airbus fleet, led by H125 helicopters, supports law enforcement, rescues and firefighting across Central Florida.
en.title: Florida's Seminole County aviation unit and its Airbus H125 fleet

body: 佛羅里達州塞米諾爾郡警長辦公室航空組組長兼首席飛行員史蒂夫·法里斯中尉，從1989年青少年時期隨警員巡邏開始，至今已在執法工作超過30年。他是土生土長的第五代佛羅里達人，在該單位1996年取得首批軍用剩餘直升機後加入航空工作，1999年成為全職飛行員，如今領導航空組。
該單位於2006年轉為全空中巴士機隊。過去20年間，10人航空團隊以空中巴士直升機累積20000飛行小時，全天候運作，每年飛行約1000小時。2025年，2架警用直升機共出勤近1400次，其中965次來自塞米諾爾郡警長辦公室，167次協助桑福德警察局，46次協助阿爾塔蒙特斯普林斯警察局。
2025年，該單位的H125直升機協助逮捕104人、執行44次專責監視任務、尋回9輛失竊車輛，並協助找到96人，其中包括30名失蹤者。同年，機組人員還執行148次灑水，協助在灌木火勢蔓延至郊區前將其撲滅，並以H125的吊掛設備與水桶，在塞米諾爾郡的荒野步道與水道執行救援與滅火任務。
zh.summary: 塞米諾爾郡警長辦公室航空組組長法里斯介紹全空中巴士機隊如何以H125直升機支援執法、救援與滅火，服務佛羅里達州中部社區。
zh.title: 佛州塞米諾爾郡航空組與空中巴士H125機隊
